title: Email Frequency: Best Practices For Email Marketers - Snovio Blog

facts.fact: According to the page, which cites Mailchimp benchmarks, the average open rate across all industries is 20.81%.
facts.quote: On average, the OR across all industries is 20.81%.

facts.fact: Snov.io recommends setting an open rate goal of approximately 20%.
facts.quote: Set the open rate goal at approximately 20% and always follow your own past campaign stats

facts.fact: According to GetResponse data cited by the page, the first newsletter sent per week has an average click-through rate of 4.88%.
facts.quote: the highest click-through rate is demonstrated by the 1st and 2nd emails sent per week (4.88% and 3.53% respectively for newsletters)

facts.fact: According to GetResponse data cited by the page, the second newsletter sent per week has an average click-through rate of 3.53%.
facts.quote: the highest click-through rate is demonstrated by the 1st and 2nd emails sent per week (4.88% and 3.53% respectively for newsletters)

facts.fact: According to GetResponse data cited by the page, the 14th and 15th newsletters sent in one week have click-through rates of 1.92% and 2.01% respectively.
facts.quote: The 14th and 15th emails (sent in one week) show 1.92% and 2.01% respectively.

facts.fact: Snov.io recommends aiming for an average click-through rate of 2.5%.
facts.quote: Aim at an average CTR of 2.5%.

facts.fact: The page states that an unsubscribe rate of around 1% is considered acceptable for novices, while professionals treat rates above 0.5% as a signal to improve emails.
facts.quote: An unsubscribe rate of around 1% is considered okay within most countries and industries IF you are a novice. But professionals stand their ground: unsubscribe rate of over 0.5%

facts.fact: The page gives 0.2% as the perfect unsubscribe rate.
Sixty-nine percent of people who unsubscribe name being tired of receiving emails as their primary reason for unsubscribing.
facts.quote: (69% of people named this reason as the primary reason for unsubscribing)

facts.fact: The page states that only 15% of people want to receive promotional or educational emails daily.
facts.quote: Of course, there are people who would like to get promotional and/or educational emails daily. But that's only 15%.

facts.fact: In Omnisend's research on its clients, 54% send emails 2-4 times per month, and Omnisend serves businesses with up to 5,000 users.
facts.quote: Most (54%) of their clients send emails 2-4 times per month, 32% – once per month.

facts.fact: In Omnisend's research on its clients, 32% send emails once per month.
facts.quote: Most (54%) of their clients send emails 2-4 times per month, 32% – once per month.
